tool_schemas.name: list_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of workspaces, optionally filtered by workspace record status and sorted by the requested field and order. Results are returned as a page of workspace objects with an opaque cursor for fetching the next page; omit cursor to start from the first page and use limit (1–100) to size the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to list workspaces and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create_issue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new issue in the specified workspace and team and returns the created issue, including its generated id, number, and identifier. You may optionally set description, project, workflow state, priority, estimate, due date, and labels at creation time. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, ids do not match expected formats, or enums/dates are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace, team, project, or state does not exist (or is not visible to you), CONFLICT if the referenced team/project/state is not in the same workspace context, UNAUTHORIZED if you lack permission to create issues for the team/workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to create the issue in.

team_id.description: Team id that owns the issue.

project_id.description: Project id to associate the issue with.

state_id.description: Workflow state id for the issue.

labels.description: List of label strings applied to the issue.

tool_schemas.name: list_issues
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of issues, optionally filtered by workspace/team/project/state, identifier/number, priority, record status, label, and created/updated time ranges, and sorted by the requested field and order. Results are returned as a page of issue objects with an opaque cursor for the next page; omit cursor to start from the first page and use limit (1–100) to size the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including malformed ids, invalid date ranges, or out-of-range limit) or malformed cursor; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to view issues in the requested scope and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

state_id.description: Filter issues by workflow state id.

label.description: Filter to issues containing a specific label.

created_after.description: Return issues created after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Return issues created before this timestamp.

updated_after.description: Return issues updated after this timestamp.

updated_before.description: Return issues updated before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: update_issue
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing issue and returns the updated issue; only provided fields are changed (including moving team, changing project or workflow state, replacing labels, or marking the record status). The service validates that referenced team/project/state ids are compatible with the issue’s workspace context and applies the update atomically. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, invalid enums/dates, or invalid payloads; raises NOT_FOUND if the issue (or any referenced team/project/state) does not exist (or is not visible to you), CONFLICT if the update would place the issue into an incompatible workspace/team/state combination or otherwise violates allowed state transitions, UNAUTHORIZED if you lack permission to edit the issue, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

project_id.description: Set/replace the project id associated with the issue.

team_id.description: Move the issue to another team.

state_id.description: Set the workflow state id for the issue.

due_date.description: Set the due date/time for the issue.

labels.description: Replace the issue labels with this list.

tool_schemas.name: get_issue_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the team’s workflow states (statuses) as a list of state objects including id, name, description, position, and type, optionally filtered by state status. Results are returned as a non-paginated list for the given team. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed team_id or invalid status filter; raises NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist (or is not visible to you), UNAUTHORIZED if you lack permission to view the team’s workflow, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

team_id.description: Team id to fetch workflow states for.

tool_schemas.name: list_teams
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of teams in the given workspace, optionally filtered by team status and sorted by the requested field and order. Results are returned as a page of team objects with an opaque cursor for fetching the next page; omit cursor to start from the first page and use limit (1–100) to size the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed workspace_id, invalid enums, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist (or is not visible to you), UNAUTHORIZED if you lack permission to list teams in the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to list teams for.

limit.description: Maximum number of teams to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of projects in the given workspace, optionally filtered by project status and start/target date ranges and sorted by the requested field and order. Results are returned as a page of project objects with an opaque cursor for fetching the next page; omit cursor to start from the first page and use limit (1–100) to size the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed workspace_id, invalid enums, invalid date ranges, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist (or is not visible to you), UNAUTHORIZED if you lack permission to list projects in the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to list projects for.

start_after.description: Return projects with start_date after this timestamp.

start_before.description: Return projects with start_date before this timestamp.

target_after.description: Return projects with target_date after this timestamp.

target_before.description: Return projects with target_date before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: search_issues
tool_schemas.description: Searches issues by text query across issue title, description, and identifier within the provided workspace/team context, optionally narrowed to a project and/or workflow state, and returns matching issues. Results are returned as a paginated list of issue objects ordered by relevance, with an opaque cursor for fetching the next page (use limit to control page size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty query, malformed ids, invalid enums, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor; raises NOT_FOUND if the specified workspace/team/project/state does not exist (or is not visible to you), CONFLICT if the provided scope ids are incompatible (for example, team/project not in the same workspace context), UNAUTHORIZED if you lack permission to search within the requested scope, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

query.description: Text query to search for in issue title/description/identifier.

project_id.description: Optionally restrict search to a project.

state_id.description: Optionally restrict search to a workflow state.

status.description: Filter matching issues by record status.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching issues to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of search results.

tool_schemas.name: get_issue
tool_schemas.description: Get detailed information about a specific issue

issue_id.description: The unique ID of the issue to retrieve (e.g., lin_issue_01HXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).

tool_schemas.name: delete_issue
tool_schemas.description: Logically deletes an issue by transitioning its status from 'active' to 'deleted' and returns the deleted issue object. Deleted issues cannot be updated afterward. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist or is already deleted; raises CONFLICT if the issue cannot transition to deleted; raises FORBIDDEN if not permitted.

metadata.name: Linear Issue and Project Management Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Linear-like workspaces containing teams, projects, and issues.
